feedback: The confession follows the strongest pre-vote distinction: the professor's own query disproves his denial of knowing the original-contents condition. His visit to the prepared glass and the active bottle complete an available means-and-opportunity account. Taking poison specifically during the preview is newly narrated action, but it is not a new external fact needed to understand the accusation; the open preview had already supplied that access. Chip and Elle resolve their denials as separate misconduct rather than acquiring surprise alibis. The professor's closing acknowledgment to Reed and Dada gives the professional shame an emotional consequence. It feels earned as a confession confirming a strong inference, although the prior evidence still allowed alternatives more than the definitive wording might suggest.
